mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS does not decline, or SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of joint decline periods.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO < 100) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) pressures corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days during high-inflation supply shocks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals sustained inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 150,000 thousand per month indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction starts exceeding 1,100 thousand units signal housing market strength that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when HOUST > 1100, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing production falling below 100 indicates industrial contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02.
